content.comment_body: Hello, I used [product_name] to create web pages on the [product_name] web server. Now, I want to use my own code across several pages. I followed the instructions provided in the [product_name] user manual, placing my code into .htm files and within the main section of the page. However, I'm experiencing issues when trying to use the fetch API—the server returns a 403 error. Is there a way to use the fetch API without encountering this error, or do you know of any alternatives? Any assistance would be appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing a 403 error when trying to utilize the fetch API in custom web pages hosted by [product_name] on the [product_name] web server. Despite following guidance from the user manual, modern JavaScript features like fetch appear blocked or unsupported due to server limitations or security measures. This restricts the user's ability to enhance the web interface and results in frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to implement the fetch API or comparable JavaScript features on custom web pages hosted by the [product_name] web server, in line with the product's manual.
